name: FAPI Validation Example Form
description: Example submodule of FAPI Validation: a demo form at /fapi-example plus a custom validator plugin, showing how to attach #validators and #filters and how to register a custom FapiValidationValidator.
project_description: fapiv_example is the example/reference submodule shipped inside the FAPI Validation project. It declares one route, fapiv_example.simple_form at /fapi-example (permission 'fapiv access example page'), served by \Drupal\fapiv_example\Form\SimpleForm, and one custom validator plugin, \Drupal\fapiv_example\Plugin\FapiValidationValidator\MyCustomValidator (id 'custom_validator'). The form demonstrates the parent module's rule syntax across several fields: a title with #validators length[5, *] and #filters uppercase + trim; a name with an array rule length[7] carrying a custom error plus the custom_validator; email, range[0, 100], ipv4 and url[absolute] fields. MyCustomValidator returns TRUE only when the value equals 'JohnDoe' and uses an error_callback (public static processError) to build its message. It depends on fapi_validation and defines only the one example-page permission; it has no config object or schema of its own.
